delete.summary:
Deletes a work order article line (j_Jobbdel row).
Replicates the PHP SlettArt flow: validation → auth guard → reservation SP → transaction delete → changelog.
Admin users (IsAdmin session flag) may delete posted article lines; non-admin users may not.
Note: the .NET auth system does not currently issue an IsAdmin claim. The admin guard defaults to false
(non-admin), which is the safe default and matches the most common caller profile.

parameters.name: workOrderPartId
parameters.description: The j_Jobbdel.ID of the article line to delete.

parameters.name: userInitials
parameters.description: Initials of the user performing the deletion, used for audit changelog.

CacheUpdateItem.description:
Request model for batch updating cache entries.
Each item can update multiple fields in a single cache key.

key.description: The Redis cache key that holds the JSON document.

fields.description:
Dictionary of field names to values.
Values can be primitives, JSON objects, JSON arrays, or null to clear.
Field names are searched recursively (case-insensitive).

parentId.description: Optional ID of the parent message, if this is a reply or child message.

subActivityId.description: SubActivityId ID of the related sub-activity. Send during request action

Bearer.name: Authorization

X-Instance-Number.name: X-Instance-Number
X-Instance-Number.description: Tenant Instance Number for multi-tenant operations. Required for all API calls.

X-Api-Key.name: X-Api-Key
X-Api-Key.description: Internal API key for machine-to-machine endpoints (Cache, Notification). Example: "X-Api-Key: {key}"
